::: {.hidden}
$$
% Espacios de matrices
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\Sym}{\mathrm{Sym}}
\newcommand{\SPD}{\mathrm{SPD}}
\newcommand{\Corr}{\mathrm{Corr}}
\newcommand{\Diag}{\mathrm{Diag}}
\newcommand{\GL}{\mathrm{GL}}
\newcommand{\Orth}{\mathrm{O}}
% Funciones matriciales (espectrales, principales)
\newcommand{\Expm}{\exp}
\newcommand{\Logm}{\log}
% Aplicaciones riemannianas (punto base en subíndice: \Exp_P, \Log_P)
\newcommand{\Exp}{\operatorname{Exp}}
\newcommand{\Log}{\operatorname{Log}}
% Distancias
\newcommand{\dAI}{d_{\mathrm{AI}}}
\newcommand{\dLE}{d_{\mathrm{LE}}}
% Operadores
\newcommand{\tr}{\operatorname{tr}}
\newcommand{\diag}{\operatorname{diag}}
$$
